sapphire-obsidian.name: Sapphire & Obsidian
sapphire-obsidian.place: A wizard's table at night: obsidian and iron, a sapphire set in the hilt, gold on the scales, parchment by day.

bronze-basalt.name: Bronze & Basalt
bronze-basalt.place: A dwarven hall: warm basalt, bronze-bound edges, the same sapphire, gold and crimson; vellum by day.

chalk-coal.name: Chalk & Coal
chalk-coal.place: Coal-black slate and white chalk: the high-contrast skin, built for 7:1 and a TV across the room.

color_tokens: Ground: the page behind everything. Plane 1 of 3.
Panel: a card or section on the ground. Plane 2 of 3.
Raised control on a panel: buttons, inputs, chips. Plane 3 of 3, always lighter than its panel.
The 1px divider between rows and around panels. At least 1.3:1 on ground and panel.
The 1px section break and the secondary button edge. At least 2:1 on panel.
The edge of anything you type into or tick: inputs, checkboxes, radios. At least 3:1 on panel and raised.
Body text and icons on ground, panel and raised.
Secondary text, labels and captions on ground, panel and raised. At least 4.5:1 on all three.
Disabled text and the draft rung. Never for text a player must read.
Fill under the pointer for quiet buttons, menu items, chips and rows. Ink reads on it.
Press this: the one primary action per screen. Never a status, never a selection.
The primary button under the pointer.
Tint behind the row or tile the primary acts on. Ink reads on it.
Words and icons on the accent.
The focus ring, the Explore graph, whose turn it is.
Answer this, and money: prices, budgets, a choice the app is waiting on.
You missed this: required fields, destructive actions, errors.
Antique gilt for the CrankMagic wordmark only. Brand, never a value: money is the brighter gold.
Words and icons on the required fill: the danger button and the error toast.
Ground of a panel that is waiting on your answer.
An input inside the decision panel.
status: Owned and physically in this deck's box. Glyph: filled disc.
Owned and sleeved in some deck (library views). Glyph: filled square.
Owned, has to be pulled from the library or another deck. Glyph: ring with a dot.
An owned copy set aside for this deck. Glyph: ring with a bar.
Bought and on its way. Glyph: right arrow.
Still to buy; it costs money, so it wears the money hue. Glyph: hollow ring.
A substitute holds the slot until the real card comes. Drawn hatched. Glyph: hatched square.
In the box but no longer in the list. Glyph: cross.
An intention, not a copy: watching a price. Glyph: dashed ring.
An intention, not a copy: on a draft list. Glyph: dotted ring.
type: Roman capitals that name places and things: page titles, the deck title, the landing hero. Weight 600. Sentence-case text sets as capitals and small capitals. It also sets the CrankMagic wordmark, in capitals at .08em, in --color-brand.
The hero is the display face at hero size: the deck title and the landing headline.
Everything that is read, chosen or counted: body, h2 and h3, labels, controls, figures, the HUD. 400 and 700.
h2, h3, deck tile names and big figures: the body face at 700.
Every page title, one rule: 40 at 1440, 30 at 390.
Big figures: cost to finish, life in the lobby.
Reading surfaces: deck guide, help, how it plays.
UI body and controls. The floor for anything a player reads. Named -size because --text-body is the body color alias.
Uppercase labels and eyebrows. The smallest size in the app.
Spaced capitals, as on the drawer titles.
Play HUD text at 100%. Multiplied by --hud-scale where it is used.
Zone captions on the board at 100%.
Set on the board root from the HUD text setting: 1, 1.25, 1.5 or 2.
table: The neon callout word over the table, italic 800. The table's one expressive face; never page type.
Where a deck tile's gradient ends under the commander art. Obsidian black; fixed.
The lobby's center card over the table; fixed.
Words on the table panel; fixed.
Pill behind words on the board.
The board's two-ring focus: halo inside ring.
Neon callout: an answer, your turn.
The Study: a walnut table under a warm lamp. The default table; the mats above are a player's choice on top of it.
